description: Source code for E1 network client factory, including notifiers for converting E1AP PDUs between packed and unpacked forms, and a client class for establishing SCTP connections to E1 gateways.

classes.name: sctp_to_e1_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier converting packed E1AP PDUs from E1 GW into unpacked PDUs and forwarding to CU-UP.

classes.name: e1_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier converting unpacked E1AP PDUs from CU-UP into packed PDUs for SCTP transmission.

classes.name: e1_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Client managing SCTP connection to E1 gateway, handling connection requests and data forwarding.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection to CU-CP and returns notifier for E1AP message forwarding.
